name: arivu
description: A multi-agent deliberation chamber on Google ADK. Five grounded Gemini advisors (economist, growth, brand, risk, ops) argue a founder's decision to convergence; a Claude-via-Vertex chair synthesises a verdict; a Claude-via-Vertex prosecutor tries to defeat it; the run halts at a single human-approval gate before any side effect fires. arivu is the faculty of judgment.

skills.name: Deliberate
skills.description: Run the full chamber on a founder's question: ground on the org's live numbers, fan out the five mantris, drive the debate loop to convergence, synthesise a Claude verdict, prosecute it adversarially, and HALT at the approval gate. Returns the verdict, defensibility score, and an ordered transcript. No side effects.
examples: Should we raise our Pro subscription to $39?
Should we sunset the free tier?

skills.name: Decide
skills.description: Execute an already-deliberated, gate-passed verdict: publish the resolution doc, flip the feature flag, and dispatch the A2A follow-up orders. Refuses unless the prior deliberation reached the gate (awaiting_approval / approved / executed) and a human approved. Honours dry-run by default.
examples: Approve and execute the verdict from the last deliberation.

notes: Served manually by the FastAPI server rather than via ADK's to_a2a() helper: to_a2a() is currently blocked by the a2a-sdk 1.1.0 restructure (a2a.server.apps was moved, breaking the import path ADK expects). Until ADK pins/adapts to the new a2a-sdk layout, the server reads this static AgentCard and exposes it on the well-known discovery path itself, and answers JSON-RPC manually. Path is a2a-sdk-version-sensitive: recent A2A spec uses /.well-known/agent-card.json, older drafts used /.well-known/agent.json — confirm against the targeted a2a-sdk version when wiring the route.
